headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 6, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5, while the New York Mets defeated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6 and the Milwaukee Brewers took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with Luinder Avila of the Kansas City Royals being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right forearm tightness. Other injured players include Blake Dunn of the Cincinnati Reds, Ryan Thompson of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Hunter Greene of the Cincinnati Reds, Sam Bachman of the Los Angeles Angels, Patrick Corbin of the Toronto Blue Jays, Trey Yesavage of the Toronto Blue Jays, and James Wood of the Washington Nationals.

In roster movement, the Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Angels Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a closely contested game. Brian Serven led the Athletics' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 13-6**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a convincing 13-6 victory over the Cleveland Guardians. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Pirates 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, ending their opponent's chances. Gary Sánchez led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Avila's Injury Update**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-hander Luinder Avila has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right forearm tightness. The move comes after Avila was initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. Berry joins the Royals after being acquired in a trade.
